units: meters, glTF frame (Godot): +Y up over the head, the cups at +-X, the wearer looking along -Z; origin between the ear canals (the middle of the line through the two cups' axes)
animations: none: the engine poses the rig

YokeL.slide: local -Y, 0..0.016 m out of the slider

YokeR.slide: local -Y, 0..0.016 m out of the slider

CupL.moves: with YokeL; tilts about local Z (front to back) a few degrees

CupR.moves: with YokeR; tilts about local Z

cord_exit.axis: local -Z: the way the cord leaves (down)

plug.frame: origin at the mating face, the shaft along +Z, the cord along -Z (RetroXR trs_plug.res)
